title: Tainted Waters
description: An unknowingly selfish mechanic, unable to save his failing business, agrees to take part in a four-man robbery. Now hiding out from the cops, he must survive the night in a room of people where he's not the most selfish.

title: False Profits
description: Delilah is imprisoned for fraud after being a part of her family's gospel group which was a front for a Ponzi scheme. She agrees to be interviewed by a local reporter about her past and her side of the crime.

title: Bottled Lust
description: Jasmine and her friends embark on a girls trip, as well as mend her heartbreak. She then meets John and is hit with a wave of feelings and butterflies. But when John starts to show his true colors, the girls end up in a dangerous situation.

title: Mistress for Hire
description: Skylar, a professional seductress hired for divorce leverage, falls for her target. As their connection grows, she reveals the truth, angering his wife. A dangerous game ensues, with love and survival on the line.

title: Deliveries From Eva
description: Disgraced music star Reese is surprised to learn that he still has a fan in the form of delivery driver, Eva. The two form an unlikely friendship that begins to sour due to Eva's growing obsession and her struggles with PTSD.

title: Bloodline of the Jewel
description: Bride to be, Nahdulay Ncala's world is turned upside down as she finds herself in the middle of a dangerous quest for a royal jewel. Traveling from Africa to America, Nahdulay connects with an unsuspecting driver who helps her uncover the truth.

title: Game of Cards
description: When data analyst Nicole Tucker's car is broken into and a mysterious military-issued card tied to her family legacy is stolen, she's thrust into a dangerous game of betrayal.

title: Nothing Even Matters
description: Paroled after five years for a victimless crime, Travis is taken in by Benny, and her mother; their generosity turns into a life of crime and murder.

title: The Groomsman
description: A co-ed bachelor and bachelorette getaway at a secluded Airbnb spirals into a night of fear and suspicion when Savanna's former love unexpectedly arrives as a groomsman in her upcoming wedding to Bryce.

title: We in This Together

description: When Devin and Imani—an estranged couple drowning under financial pressure—receive an unmarked briefcase containing a life-changing sum of money, they find themselves faced with an impossible decision.

title: Judge Knott
description: When veteran judge Wiley Knott is pulled over for a minor traffic stop, he assumes it's nothing like always. However, this time the police arrest him, and take his five-year-old granddaughter.

description: Jacob is a successful chef with big dreams of opening his own restaurant, but struggles in his personal life due to his demanding girlfriend, Drina. But when Lisa comes along, he sees a window to be something bigger.

title: Then There Was You
description: Lady's man Kingston gets more than he bargains for when he encounters Shandre, a spoken-word artist who introduces him to a lifestyle deeply rooted in African American culture.

title: False Profits
description: Delilah is imprisoned for fraud after being a part of her family's gospel group which was a front for a Ponzi scheme. She agrees to be interviewed by a local reporter about her past and her side of the crime.

title: Teacher's Pet
description: A young and charming student enters a new school, but he has a way to get what he wants, including manipulating his teacher. When she tries to end their inappropriate relationship, people start to die around her.

title: I Hate I Love You
description: A successful power couple is tested by betrayal and illegal activity. Both love and business face being destroyed.

title: Carmen and Magic
description: When single father Drew starts dating his daughter's school principal, her new friend Magic convinces Carmen to disrupt their relationship, revealing Magic's true nature.

title: Office Secrets
description: As Alvin climbs to the top, he uncovers Mr. Leonard's dark secrets, setting off a chain reaction of suspense. Meanwhile, Victoria's vendetta adds a spicy twist to the mix, creating a captivating story where love, revenge, and corporate chaos collide.

description: When Malorie's sister, Monica, disappears, everyone around her tells her to grieve and move on. Determined to bring her justice, Malorie embarks on a search for the truth. But when she meets Tyriq, his motives may not be as pure as they seem.

title: A Secret Lie in Love
description: Clarice and Chase Scott have the perfect suburban life on the outside. But, their marriage that was built on passion, has become a battlefield of deceit, infidelity and betrayal. Clarice finds solace in the arms of another man.

title: Her Best Revenge
description: A group of five fraternity brothers reunite after a decade apart, only to be haunted by a deadly secret from their past.

title: Till Lies Do Us Part
description: Amina and Alex announce their engagement and plan a destination wedding. As the romantic and loving getaway goes along, betrayals and hidden truths come to the surface, causing chaos and drama.

title: Don't Push That!
description: Three coworkers stumble upon a device labeled DPT that can create the worst possible outcome of any action or decision. Once the button on the device is pressed, it must be pressed every 11 minutes to prevent further destruction.

title: Breaking Free
description: When his wife is murdered in their own home, Joe, an undercover cop, spirals out of control with alcohol and substance abuse.

description: Trina, a young model, becomes entangled with Max. As their relationship deepens, she uncovers his dark secrets: a double life, a psychotic ex-girlfriend, and a dangerous obsession.

description: Symone, a spirited and vibrant plus-size woman in her 30s, finds herself navigating the unpredictable world of modern dating while grappling with the emotional aftermath of her one-night stand with Andre, her high school sweetheart.

title: Bloodline of the Jewel
description: Bride to be, Nahdulay Ncala's world is turned upside down as she finds herself in the middle of a dangerous quest for a royal jewel. Traveling from Africa to America, Nahdulay connects with an unsuspecting driver who helps her uncover the truth.

title: Stick Em Game
description: Struggling to launch her social media career, Elise decides to switch to viral pranks. When one prank on an old acquaintance goes terribly wrong, a local gang leader is out for revenge. With her best friend's help, Elise must fight to survive.

title: Breaking Free
description: When his wife is murdered in their own home, Joe, an undercover cop, spirals out of control with alcohol and substance abuse.

title: Rhythm and Revenge
description: After losing her parents, Journi, a talented but troubled teenager, moves in with her aunt and cousin for a fresh start. As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her.

description: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity.

description: Seduced by her boyfriend's charming son, a woman soon finds herself trapped in a dangerous obsession that will push her to her limits.

title: But I'm Married
description: Kimora and Jamal's seemingly perfect marriage falters. Seeking to reignite passion, Kimora explores unconventional options, including a third person. This decision unleashes a web of lies and betrayal, forcing Kimora to confront hidden desires.

title: Redemption
description: Lost and grieving, Chris seeks solace in the wrong crowd. A chance encounter with the enigmatic Patrick leads him down a dangerous path, forcing him to confront his own morality and the consequences of his choices.

title: What I'd Do for Love
description: After exacting a bitter revenge on her cheating ex-husband, Greer Patterson gets back in the dating game to find new love at all costs.

title: The New Girl
description: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica's seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister.

title: Deceptive Touch
description: Cam believes she's finally found "The One" in her charismatic boyfriend Ant. Everything seems perfect until a shocking discovery about Ant's past threatens to unravel their idyllic life.

title: Shotlanta
description: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, immigrates to Atlanta. Determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path.

title: Kitty Hallow Killer
description: Mason and Jessica get into a horrible car accident on their wedding day, Jessica wakes up with no memory of her life or even her husband. As her memories start to come back in pieces, she is afraid that her husband could be a known serial killer.

title: Cougar
description: An older woman, Christine moves in next door to a mother and her son. Christine then develops a connection with Brandon, involving a deadly game of lies, sex, and deceit.

title: The Good Sister
description: Raven moves in with her sister Devin and her husband in Atlanta, where she begins to dig her claws into Devin's life and home, and seducing her husband. Devin must make a choice that could be deadly to save her own life and happiness.

title: The Drive
description: A doctor is driving home from a conference when he learns his daughter has been kidnapped and the betrayal comes from those closest to him. The certainty that someone within his trusted circle is responsible turns the journey into a spiral of shock.

title: ToxiCity
description: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order.

title: The Only Child
description: Chris has a wonderful and thriving childhood with her loving family. When her mother dies tragically in a car accident, she begins to go down a dark and sinister path, and develops a fierce devotion to her father.

title: Hidden Agenda
description: Bright and gifted Jessica takes on a side hustle tutoring popular football star, Ryan. After the football team wins the championship game, Ryan decides to throw an after party at his house. When Ryan is found dead, multiple people are suspects.

title: Three Secrets
description: A couple tries to bring life back into their marriage by bringing in another woman, but the relationship is built on lies.
